If downloads fail repeatedly, check your: If downloads fail repeatedly, check your internet connection, verify the repository URL is reachable in a browser, and review the activity log for specific error messages. If the app reports hash mismatches after: If the app reports hash mismatches after an update, use Recheck repository integrity to fetch fresh remote data and rebuild stored checksums from scratch.

Third-party overlays such as NVIDIA GeFo: Third-party overlays such as NVIDIA GeForce Experience, NVIDIA App, Discord, Steam, Bandicam, and similar screen-capture or recording tools can attach to Foxy on startup and cause unwanted pop-ups, performance issues, or rendering glitches.
Foxy is a desktop application, not a gam: Foxy is a desktop application, not a game, so it does not benefit from in-game overlays. You can safely exclude Foxy from these overlays without losing any functionality.
NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App:: NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App: open the app, go to Settings, find the in-game overlay or Games and Apps section, and add Foxy to the excluded applications list.
If you do not use NVIDIA features like i: If you do not use NVIDIA features like instant replay, screenshots, or recording, you can disable the NVIDIA in-game overlay globally in NVIDIA App settings.
NVIDIA classifies any DirectX 12 or Vulk: NVIDIA classifies any DirectX 12 or Vulkan application as a potential game. This behavior is not specific to Foxy and there is no supported way for Foxy to opt out programmatically.
Discord overlay: open Discord, go to Use: Discord overlay: open Discord, go to User Settings, Game Activity, then either remove Foxy from the detected games list or disable the overlay for it.
Steam overlay: if Foxy was launched thro: Steam overlay: if Foxy was launched through Steam, open Steam, go to Settings, In-Game, and disable the Steam overlay for Foxy via its properties. Foxy is normally not launched through Steam, so this usually does not apply.
Screen-capture tools such as Bandicam, O: Screen-capture tools such as Bandicam, OBS, ShadowPlay, and Xbox Game Bar: exclude Foxy from their auto-capture lists. On Windows you can also disable Xbox Game Bar capture for Foxy under Windows Settings, Gaming, Captures.
After changing overlay settings, fully c: After changing overlay settings, fully close and relaunch Foxy so the overlay hooks do not re-attach to the running process.
If the NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVID: If the NVIDIA GeForce Experience or NVIDIA App overlay pops up every time Foxy launches, add Foxy to the excluded applications list in NVIDIA App settings. See the Third-party overlays help tab for details.

Foxy includes broad localization support: Foxy includes broad localization support with locale-aware pluralization, formatting, and dedicated font coverage for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and Hebrew.
If a legacy setup contains multiple entr: If a legacy setup contains multiple entries from the same source, Foxy can migrate them as separate profile variants instead of collapsing them into one setup.
If your Arma 3 profile files are stored: If your Arma 3 profile files are stored in Documents or OneDrive, configure a dedicated profile root so Foxy can launch with -profiles=<path> and avoid sync conflicts.
Repository cards use a denser layout and: Repository cards use a denser layout and can be reordered by drag and drop, so keep the repositories you use most near the top.
After a temporary failure, Foxy retries: After a temporary failure, Foxy retries the update automatically while it stays open, with a countdown and Cancel retry. Turn off Retry temporary download failures automatically in Application settings to retry yourself.
A paused repository update stays paused: A paused repository update stays paused after you close Foxy. Resume checks the current update plan before downloading, and scheduled and bulk updates leave it paused.
Cancel stops the whole folder, repositor: Cancel stops the whole folder, repository space, or scheduled run. Closing Foxy during an update waits for the previous files to be restored first.
You can cancel an active sync while Foxy: You can cancel an active sync while Foxy is hashing or downloading. Foxy aborts pending work, clears transient state, and returns progress to a clean idle state.
Active mod downloads bubble toward the t: Active mod downloads bubble toward the top of the update list so the most advanced work remains visible during long syncs.
Download speed and ETA estimates use rec: Download speed and ETA estimates use recent transfer history and are smoothed for slow disks or uneven networks.
Foxy cleans temporary download parts aft: Foxy cleans temporary download parts after aborted or failed transfers so stale partial files do not accumulate.
Use a custom profile root when you need: Use a custom profile root when you need Arma 3 to store profile data outside the default Documents path. Foxy passes that path to Arma 3 as -profiles=<path>.
Avoid OneDrive-synchronized profile path: Avoid OneDrive-synchronized profile paths. Foxy warns about OneDrive because cloud sync can lock or corrupt Arma 3 profile files.
Profile names and editor mission names s: Profile names and editor mission names support UTF-8 text, so non-English names should display and launch correctly.
If an update is replacing files the game: If an update is replacing files the game needs, Launch and Join wait in a queue you can cancel. Foxy checks readiness again when the update ends, and a failed update does not start the game.
If a server is online but does not repor: If a server is online but does not report its addon list, Foxy offers Retry addon check, Join without addon check, or Cancel.
If a frozen Workshop copy is missing, Fo: If a frozen Workshop copy is missing, Foxy asks before using live files for that launch. If extra files cannot be prepared, choose Retry, Continue for this launch, or Cancel.
When joining a server, Foxy can warn if: When joining a server, Foxy can warn if the server reports required addons that are available locally but disabled for the selected launch.
Offline servers do not show a Join actio: Offline servers do not show a Join action because there is no live target to connect to.
Repository space names and labels allow: Repository space names and labels allow longer values, so community names and grouping labels can be more descriptive.
Turn on Filtered only in an addon tab to: Turn on Filtered only in an addon tab to make Enable all and Disable all affect only addons matching the current filters.
Right-click an addon to open its Steam W: Right-click an addon to open its Steam Workshop or Arma Reforger Workshop page in your browser.
Addons can be marked as favorites and fi: Addons can be marked as favorites and filtered by favorite state, which is useful in large repositories with many optional or external addons.
Optional addon choices persist across re: Optional addon choices persist across refreshes and restarts, so disabled optional addons are not silently re-enabled or re-downloaded.
Repository metadata can mark client-side: Repository metadata can mark client-side addons and server-required addons so launch prompts can explain what Foxy is about to enable.
Editor Missions are shown inside the rep: Editor Missions are shown inside the repository view so mission work stays close to the addons, profiles, and server setup it depends on.
Use the Editor Missions section to open,: Use the Editor Missions section to open, duplicate, delete, or launch Eden Editor for detected singleplayer and multiplayer mission folders.
Mission subfolders are scanned recursive: Mission subfolders are scanned recursively, so nested mission organization is supported.
Use the terrain filter beside Show folde: Use the terrain filter beside Show folders to narrow the mission list to one map when a profile contains many missions.
Use the mission context menu to remove a: Use the mission context menu to remove addon dependencies from mission.sqm when you need a cleaner mission dependency list.
If additional or external addons are ena: If additional or external addons are enabled, Foxy warns before launching Eden Editor because saving can write those addon dependencies into mission.sqm.
The editor launch warning lets you launc: The editor launch warning lets you launch with addons, launch without additional/external addons, or cancel.
When an editor launch starts, Foxy shows: When an editor launch starts, Foxy shows a toast and suppresses repeated launch clicks while Arma 3 is starting.
Settings can hide the Editor Missions li: Settings can hide the Editor Missions list globally, and repository settings can override that choice for a specific repository.
Wiping repository database entries also: Wiping repository database entries also clears legacy metadata that could otherwise leave stale MD5 protocol or update-available banners behind.
Foxy asks for confirmation before profil: Foxy asks for confirmation before profile deletion, profile reset, and full settings reset so destructive actions are harder to trigger by accident.
Use Export logs to ZIP to package diagno: Use Export logs to ZIP to package diagnostic logs and the last prepared cleanup list into a timestamped archive for support. The button is in Settings and the footer, and next to most error messages.
Use the repository view visibility setti: Use the repository view visibility settings to show or hide the Editor Missions list and Servers list globally, with per-repository overrides when needed.
Use Game space settings to show or hide: Use Game space settings to show or hide the Editor Missions list and Servers list for that game space, with per-repository overrides when needed.
If the app update URL field is empty, Fo: If the app update URL field is empty, Foxy can fill it from repository-space metadata first and repository metadata second. A non-empty manual value is treated as your override.
Log files older than 90 days are cleaned: Log files older than 90 days are cleaned up automatically, and Foxy keeps up to 16 recent log files.
Foxy can use WGPU or Glow for the UI ren: Foxy can use WGPU or Glow for the UI renderer. Auto is recommended because it allows Foxy to recover when a graphics driver or WGPU path is unstable.
Choose Auto, WGPU, or Glow in Applicatio: Choose Auto, WGPU, or Glow in Application settings. Renderer changes take effect after restart.
If Foxy detects that the previous run cr: If Foxy detects that the previous run crashed inside egui-wgpu, it writes a recovery marker and switches to Glow on the next launch.
When Foxy auto-switches to Glow, it show: When Foxy auto-switches to Glow, it shows a startup notice so you know why the renderer changed. Dismissing the notice clears the notice marker.
Glow provides an OpenGL fallback for sys: Glow provides an OpenGL fallback for systems where Vulkan, DirectX, drivers, overlays, or WGPU are unstable.
Foxy profiles runtime memory pressure as: Foxy profiles runtime memory pressure as normal, constrained, or severe, then uses that tier when choosing hashing and download concurrency.
Hash scheduling applies safe caps for au: Hash scheduling applies safe caps for automatic and manual profiles when memory is constrained or severe.
Auto hash-profile benchmarking narrows c: Auto hash-profile benchmarking narrows candidate profiles under constrained resources and records cap reasons in logs.
Download scheduling adjusts large-file s: Download scheduling adjusts large-file slots, small-file slots, active range requests, per-file workers, and chunk targets from runtime limits.
The hashing and sync pipelines include o: The hashing and sync pipelines include optimized file I/O paths, including faster local content hashing for gzip-like payloads.
The UI reduces unnecessary idle redraw w: The UI reduces unnecessary idle redraw work, and repository sync states avoid extra recalculation when nothing meaningful changed.
Repeated clicks on launch, update, and o: Repeated clicks on launch, update, and other long-running actions are suppressed while the operation is starting or already in progress.
If Foxy rejects a profile path, check wh: If Foxy rejects a profile path, check whether it is inside OneDrive or contains characters that are unsafe for cross-platform file handling.
If Foxy starts with Glow after a crash,: If Foxy starts with Glow after a crash, review the Renderer and performance help tab and keep Auto selected unless you have a specific reason to force WGPU.
Foxy keeps game mod repositories, addon: Foxy keeps game mod repositories, addon selection, launch settings, downloads, and recovery tools in one desktop app. Arma 3, Total War: WARHAMMER III, and Arma Reforger are supported, and Generic game covers any other game.
Each game lives in its own game space wi: Each game lives in its own game space with separate repositories, settings, and database. See the Game spaces help tab for details.
The panel at the top of the sidebar show: The panel at the top of the sidebar shows the open game space. Use Switch to change game spaces, the gear icon to open Game space settings, and the game logo to open the game space overview.
Use Game space settings for everything t: Use Game space settings for everything that belongs to one game, such as the game directory, launch checks, profiles, Steam Workshop mods, and additional search folders.
Use the Scheduling tab in Settings to ru: Use the Scheduling tab in Settings to run rechecks and downloads at a chosen time, and the Benchmarks tab to save and compare how your checks and updates performed.
The activity log in the bottom right sho: The activity log in the bottom right shows what the app is doing now and keeps recent core messages available for troubleshooting.
Check that the right game is open. The t: Check that the right game is open. The top of the sidebar shows the active game space; use Switch there to create or open a game space for another game.
For other games, open Game space setting: For other games, open Game space settings from the gear icon in the sidebar and set the game directory, or use Auto-detect when it is available to find it from your Steam library.
A game space is a separate workspace for: A game space is a separate workspace for one game, with its own repositories, repository spaces, game settings, mod stores, benchmarks, and database. Exactly one game space is open at a time, and Foxy reopens the last one on the next launch.
Supported games are Arma 3, Total War: W: Supported games are Arma 3, Total War: WARHAMMER III, and Arma Reforger. Generic game covers any other game: you set the executable, launch arguments, mods manifest file, and optional Steam App ID yourself.
The panel at the top of the sidebar show: The panel at the top of the sidebar shows the open game space. Click Switch to open the Game spaces list, the gear icon to open Game space settings, or the game logo to open the game space overview.
In the Game spaces list, use Create game: In the Game spaces list, use Create game space, choose the game, and enter a name. You can create several game spaces for the same game to keep separate setups apart.
A Generic game space can add repositorie: A Generic game space can add repositories that deliver mods or the game itself. A downloaded game appears in the Game section of the repository view instead of the addon list, and Launch starts it directly. Updates download only the changed parts of the game files.
Use Open game space to switch without re: Use Open game space to switch without restarting Foxy. Pending changes are saved first, and a failed save offers Retry, Discard changes and switch, or Cancel switching. Checks, downloads, and Steam Workshop tasks must finish before you switch.
Remove game space deletes only the Foxy: Remove game space deletes only the Foxy workspace: its repository list, game settings, and local database. Game installs and downloaded mods stay on disk.
Game space settings show a tab for the g: Game space settings show a tab for the game itself plus Profiles, Steam Workshop, Additional search folders, and TS3 Plugin. Tabs only appear when the game supports them.
You can open the settings of a game spac: You can open the settings of a game space that is not open. Changes are saved to that game space and take effect when you open it. Profiles, Steam Workshop, and TS3 Plugin need the game space to be open.
Rename in Game space settings changes on: Rename in Game space settings changes only the name shown in Foxy. The game space folder and its data stay where they are.
The game space overview shows repositori: The game space overview shows repositories, repository spaces, unique addons, mods on disk, last launch and update times, TeamSpeak 3 status, and your recent benchmarks.
Language, renderer, backups, and other A: Language, renderer, backups, and other Application settings are shared by all game spaces. Scheduled jobs, cleanup folders, additional search folders, and pending updates belong to the game space they were created in.
When you upgrade from a Foxy version wit: When you upgrade from a Foxy version without game spaces, your existing setup moves into an Arma 3 game space automatically. The previous files are kept as .pre-gamespaces.bak copies.
Each game space stores its data under ga: Each game space stores its data under games/<game space> in the Foxy config directory. Only one Foxy window or command can use a config directory at a time, even for different game spaces.
If something looks wrong after an interr: If something looks wrong after an interrupted or unusual update, start with Quick local check, then Refresh, and only use Recheck repository integrity if the normal checks do not resolve it.
With Check Steam is running before launc: With Check Steam is running before launching turned on in Game space settings, Foxy warns when Steam is not running and offers to start it. Check TeamSpeak is running before joining does the same for TeamSpeak 3. Configure post-launch behavior in Settings to close or hide to tray.
Use the Profiles tab in Game space setti: Use the Profiles tab in Game space settings to clone, rename, or delete Arma 3 player profiles. Deleted profiles are moved to the Foxy backup directory, and changes are blocked while Arma 3 is running.
For Total War: WARHAMMER III, Foxy write: For Total War: WARHAMMER III, Foxy writes the enabled mods to used_mods.txt in the game directory before launch. For Arma Reforger, Foxy builds the -addons and -addonsDir launch parameters from the enabled addons.
Enabled extra files are copied into the: Enabled extra files are copied into the game directory before each launch. See the Steam Workshop and extra files help tab.
For Steam games, Foxy manages Steam Work: For Steam games, Foxy manages Steam Workshop mods next to repository content. Open Game space settings and choose the Steam Workshop tab while that game space is open.
Managed extra files and .foxypack config: Managed extra files and .foxypack config packs cover files that are not mods and let you move a whole setup to another machine.
The game space needs a Steam App ID. Bui: The game space needs a Steam App ID. Built-in games have one already; for Generic game, set it in Game space settings.
Use Import share code to paste Workshop: Use Import share code to paste Workshop ids, Workshop links, or a pipe-separated list from a friend. Keep Subscribe and download through Steam on to download the mods, and turn on Freeze each mod after downloading to pin them right away.
Copy share code copies your enabled mods: Copy share code copies your enabled mods as a pipe-separated list that other mod managers understand.
Paste a friend's share code into Compare: Paste a friend's share code into Compare with to check it against your setup. Foxy shows when your enabled mods match, when the load order differs, and offers Import missing to download only the mods you do not have yet.
The state checksum covers your enabled m: The state checksum covers your enabled mods, the game build, and load order. Click it to copy; a friend with the same checksum is running the same setup.
Enable or disable each mod in the list,: Enable or disable each mod in the list, and use Load earlier and Load later to change the load order.
Freeze keeps a private copy of a mod at: Freeze keeps a private copy of a mod at its current version so a Workshop update cannot change your setup. Unfreeze follows Steam updates again, and Freeze all freezes every mod at once.
Import bundle previews the changes. Merg: Import bundle previews the changes. Merge keeps your unlisted selections, while Match adopts the bundle's selection and order and disables unlisted items without deleting them.
Export bundle writes a .foxyshare file w: Export bundle writes a .foxyshare file with the mod list and every frozen copy. Import bundle reads a .foxyshare file a friend sent you.
Use Refresh to fetch titles, sizes, and: Use Refresh to fetch titles, sizes, and update times from Steam, and Open to view a mod's Workshop page.
Remove takes a mod out of this game spac: Remove takes a mod out of this game space. Turn on Also delete the downloaded files and frozen copies to free the disk space as well.
Extra files apply in order, and later en: Extra files apply in order, and later entries win at shared destinations. Foxy asks before overwriting a destination that changed, and restores the previous files if a launch fails.
Managed extra files store config folders: Managed extra files store config folders and other files that are not mods inside Foxy, and copy the enabled ones into the game directory before each launch. Manage them on the command line with foxy config extra-file.
A .foxypack config pack exports a game s: A .foxypack config pack exports a game space's repositories, Workshop ids, profiles, and extra files so you can import them on another machine. Packs reference mods by id and never carry mod files. Use foxy config export and foxy config import.
Arma Reforger Workshop addons are manage: Arma Reforger Workshop addons are managed by GUID on the command line with foxy game reforger, including addon freezing.
Use the TS3 Plugin tab in Game space set: Use the TS3 Plugin tab in Game space settings to discover, install, and update TeamSpeak 3 plugins found in your repository addons.
Use the Scheduling tab to recheck and do: Use the Scheduling tab to recheck and download updates at a chosen time, once or on a recurring schedule, for a single repository, a repository space, or a custom selection. Jobs only run while Foxy is open.
A scheduled job that falls due while oth: A scheduled job that falls due while other work is running waits and starts when that work finishes. It counts as missed only if Foxy was closed or the computer was asleep.
A scheduled job can close Foxy or shut d: A scheduled job can close Foxy or shut down the PC when it finishes, optionally only if everything succeeded. Shutdown starts a 60-second countdown that you can cancel.
Turn on Extended diagnostics logging in: Turn on Extended diagnostics logging in Application settings when you report a performance problem. It writes detailed hashing, download, database, disk, and memory diagnostics to the log files.
Show FPS counter and Show memory diagnos: Show FPS counter and Show memory diagnostics icon in footer in Application settings help diagnose UI performance and memory use.
Open the activity log from the bottom-ri: Open the activity log from the bottom-right footer button when you want to see current work, recent core events, or troubleshooting details.
Benchmarks record how a recheck, update,: Benchmarks record how a recheck, update, or redownload performed on your computer, so you can compare runs over time or attach them when you report a performance problem.
Benchmarks are stored per game space, to: Benchmarks are stored per game space, together with their metrics, charts, and the matching slice of the log.
Open Settings, choose the Benchmarks tab: Open Settings, choose the Benchmarks tab, and turn on Enable benchmarks. Extended diagnostics logging stays on while benchmarks are enabled, so the log files grow faster.
Start a recheck, update, or redownload y: Start a recheck, update, or redownload yourself. When it finishes, Foxy asks whether to save the run. Choose Save benchmark to keep it or Discard to skip it.
The Benchmarks tab lists your saved runs: The Benchmarks tab lists your saved runs. Use Search benchmarks, the action, outcome, and repository filters, and the sort order to find the run you need.
Open a benchmark to see stage durations,: Open a benchmark to see stage durations, files checked, download sizes and speeds, patch savings, peak memory, average CPU, power source, and charts for CPU, memory, disk writes, and transfer rates.
Speed of light shows how close each oper: Speed of light shows how close each operation ran to its reference, such as a bound, the run's own peak, or a nominal device rate. Cancelled or failed runs are excluded from best-case comparison.
Use Add notes about this run and Save no: Use Add notes about this run and Save notes to remember what was different, for example another disk, network, or hashing profile.
Mark runs as Favourite, hide runs you do: Mark runs as Favourite, hide runs you do not need with Hide benchmark, or delete them with Remove benchmark. Show hidden brings hidden runs back into the list.
Select two benchmarks and choose Compare: Select two benchmarks and choose Compare selected to see them side by side. Swap A and B exchanges the sides, and Oldest as A keeps the older run on the A side.
Use Export benchmark to ZIP to package a: Use Export benchmark to ZIP to package a benchmark with its charts and log slice for support, and Open benchmarks folder to see the stored files.
The game space overview lists your recen: The game space overview lists your recent benchmarks. Use Open benchmarks there to jump to the Benchmarks tab.
Choose a Hashing profile in Application: Choose a Hashing profile in Application settings: Conservative for constrained systems, Balanced for mixed systems, Aggressive for systems that can sustain high concurrency, or Auto to benchmark initial hashing work and pick the fastest profile.
CPU usage limit in Application settings: CPU usage limit in Application settings caps how much of the whole computer's processor time Foxy's hashing, checking, and patching use on average, 90% by default, so a game or other program keeps the rest. Tick No limit to let Foxy use every thread when nothing else needs it.
CPU Threads in Application settings sets: CPU Threads in Application settings sets how many processor threads Foxy plans hashing, scanning, and checking work around. Auto uses every detected thread. Safe limits keeps a manual count within the detected threads; turn it off to enter any count.
Work priority and Low disk priority in A: Work priority and Low disk priority in Application settings let a running game keep the processor and the disk while Foxy checks or downloads. The interface and the programs Foxy launches keep normal priority.
Storage type overrides the detected driv: Storage type overrides the detected drive type when detection is wrong, Memory pressure forces how much memory Foxy plans around, and Progress frame rate lowers how often progress is redrawn.
Proxy in Application settings uses the s: Proxy in Application settings uses the system proxy by default. Choose No proxy to connect directly, or Manual proxy to enter an HTTP or HTTPS proxy with an optional user name, password, and list of hosts to reach directly.
Skip unchanged files after a database re: Skip unchanged files after a database reset lets Foxy trust files it already verified and that Windows shows as untouched since, instead of reading them again. An integrity recheck always reads every file.
To measure how a check or update perform: To measure how a check or update performs on your computer, save it as a benchmark. See the Benchmarks help tab.
The same Foxy program also works as a co: The same Foxy program also works as a command-line tool, so you can script checks, updates, launches, and configuration. It uses the same config directory and game spaces as the desktop app.
Use foxy settings show and foxy settings: Use foxy settings show and foxy settings set to read and change settings, including the CPU, priority, proxy, and retry options.
Run foxy --help to list every command, a: Run foxy --help to list every command, and add --help after any command to see its options.
